review_notes: I read the whole file and checked Mathlib's `Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/SheafCohomology/Cech.lean`. It defines only `cosimplicialObjectFunctor`, `cochainComplexFunctor` and `cechComplexFunctor`. Mathlib has no map of Čech complexes induced by a morphism of covers, no augmentation, and no homotopy between such maps. So `cechComplexMap`, `cechAugmentation` and `cechComplexMapHomotopy` are not competing versions of existing concepts. They are built from Mathlib pieces: `alternatingCofaceMapComplex`, `AlternatingFaceMapComplex.ε`, `Arrow.mapCechNerveHomotopy` and `FormalCoproduct.cech`. The private helpers `cechXIso₀`, `cechXIso₁`, `cechδ`, `restrict`, `lift₀`, `augmentation₀` and `singleIso` are local bookkeeping. `cechXIso₀` and `cechXIso₁` are `Iso.refl` definitions that record definitional identifications, not parallel concepts. I did not search the other TauCeti files, only the supplied Mathlib roots, so I may have missed duplication inside TauCeti itself. I found nothing in this file that justifies consolidation.
